title: Transparency locks the system into naive realism

statements.text: Because the instruments of representation cannot be represented as such, a system with transparent representations is entangled in naive realism: its experience has an untranscendably realistic character, and it cannot think its way out of its phenomenal model of reality by cognitive operations alone. The epistemic counterpart is autoepistemic closure, a built-in blind spot for the self-constructed nature of experience.
